scope: Current-main merge control for the production Solid builder and opt-in native startup trace. This adds a new current-lock host observation and does not relabel historical artifacts or repeat the twelve-case qualification.
sourceStability: All 81 recorded source/controller/inspector files were hashed before native compilation and after each application control; no captured file changed. Both generated module and executable manifests were separately checked.
limits: One lifecycle and one caret control ran once in each mode. These narrow merge controls do not replace the required hosted release-host native suite or claim complete Unicode/IME/platform coverage.

Lifecycle traces require five actual GPUI windows, all 35 native open markers, five painted window identities and joined exit 0. Their unchanged bounds are 5 seconds per request and 45 seconds per fixture; phase clocks are process-relative and not comparable across processes.

Caret cases require actual XTest pointer/key delivery, exact full-tree paint of AxBCD at revision 1, OS close and zero observed owned survivors. The AOT caret screenshot was visually inspected; automated pixel/OCR assertions remain unsupported.

Both executables have actual compiled-program metadata, JIT unused and 27 removed ranges; interpreters remain present. The caret development module and AOT input are identical and contain production Solid dependencies.
The new host is development profile and uses software Vulkan. No release performance, input-to-presentation latency, physical-input or hardware-GPU claim follows.
Issue #296 remains open; the original hosted first-open failure is retained, and passing local controls do not explain it. Issue #287 and its unchanged WeakRef oracle also remain open.
